notes: Chronological install order is load-bearing: telemetry consent first, then the codebase graph (graft build) so PRD inspection and all later agent work can use it, then skills, then PRD + host registration, then workspace-local MCP entries, then verification.

components.name: Graft codebase context graph
components.telemetry: Ships a telemetry module with a consent prompt. The suite runs `graft telemetry disable` BEFORE any other graft command.
quirks: Must run with cwd=target directory (--dir flag is unreliable on Windows; verified 2026-10-13).
Overwrites .gitignore: installer backs it up and merges graft lines back (verified overwrite 2026-10-13).

graft init only registers MCP globally (~/.gemini/...); installer passes --no-global --no-mcp and registers workspace-local MCP entries itself so no machine-wide files change (except the telemetry preference).

components.name: Hallmark anti-AI-slop design skill
components.notes: 68KB SKILL.md exceeds the 500-line guidance; reported as a warning, installed verbatim (third-party files are never edited).

notIncluded.name: uiux-skills (exact name)
notIncluded.reason: No repository by that exact name exists (searched 2026-10-13). Overlapping UI kits (ui-ux-kit, ux-ui-agent-skills, ui-ux-pro-max, ultimate.UIUX.design.skills) were deliberately NOT bundled: contradictory design doctrines in one project fight each other and bloat agent context. Hallmark covers the need; add alternatives via --only/--skip workflow or extend the manifest.

notIncluded.name: graft-org/graft
notIncluded.reason: Different product (private-beta enterprise tool contracts, waitlist). Not the codebase-graph graft.

notIncluded.name: JSLEEKR/graft
notIncluded.reason: Claude-Code-only pipeline compiler, 0 stars, single provider. Not agent-portable.

notIncluded.name: AEndrix03/Graft
notIncluded.reason: Different product (persistent agent memory, Apache-2.0, 33 stars) despite the similar name. Not the codebase-graph tool this suite pins (trailhq/Graft).

notIncluded.name: enulus/OpenPackage (opkg)
notIncluded.reason: Real (Apache-2.0) skill/agent/MCP installer supporting OpenCode+Antigravity, but installs latest with no pin/lock/rollback/offline concept (verified in README 2026-10-13). The suite keeps deterministic pinned installs; OpenPackage remains a valid manual alternative for latest-version installs.

notIncluded.name: OlegHQ/agentpack
notIncluded.reason: Real (MIT, Go, v0.4.8) manifest+lockfile package manager for agents incl. OpenCode/Antigravity, but 16 stars and days old (verified 2026-10-13). Its good ideas (lockfile, doctor/verify) were adopted natively in suite/install.mjs instead of adding a Go toolchain dependency on an unproven binary.

notIncluded.name: wshobson/agents (wholesale)
notIncluded.reason: Real (MIT, 40k stars) marketplace, but a bulk collection: wholesale inclusion contradicts the no-bloat rule (contradictory doctrines, context explosion). Cherry-picking is possible later via the manifest workflow.
